summary.text: Renée Price is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 50, which covers Caswell and Orange counties, and is the incumbent on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as consultant.

paragraphs.text: Renée Price won the Democratic primary for North Carolina House District 50 on March 3, 2026, receiving 74.0 percent of the vote and defeating Mary Lucas and Brandall Redd.
The Republican primary for the seat was canceled.
The General Assembly lists two terms in the House for Price and a mailing address in Hillsborough.
